pois.name: Varkala Cliff & North Cliff Walkway
pois.address: North Cliff, Kurakkanni, Varkala, Kerala 695141, India
pois.description: Dramatic red laterite coastal cliffs overlooking the Arabian Sea, flanked by ocean-view cafes and artisanal shops.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Geological natural monument with stunning panoramic sunset views
✓ Breezy paved promenade connecting secluded cove beaches
pois.tip: Sunset is best enjoyed from the cliff-edge cafes with fresh coconut water.

pois.name: Papanasam Beach (Varkala Beach)
pois.address: Varkala Beach Rd, Varkala, Kerala 695141, India
pois.description: Sacred white-sand beach beneath the cliffs, renowned for natural mineral springs believed to have holy cleansing properties.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Pristine coastal beach with sacred natural spring waters
✓ Excellent swimming and relaxed coastal walks
pois.tip: Swim in marked lifeguard zones as currents can be powerful during high tide.

pois.name: Janardhana Swamy Temple
pois.description: Ancient 2,000-year-old Vaishnavite temple featuring classical Kerala wooden architecture, copper roof tiles, and historic stone carvings.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Sacred 2,000-year-old heritage temple known as the Dakshin Varanasi
✓ Traditional Kerala temple courtyard and holy spring pool
pois.tip: Traditional temple dress code observed: men remove shirts before entering the inner sanctum.

pois.name: Kappil Lake & Beach
pois.description: Idyllic confluence where tranquil backwater lake and coconut groves meet the Arabian Sea along a scenic coastal bridge road.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Unique natural backwater lake meeting the open ocean
✓ Serene paddle boating and quiet shoreline walks away from crowds
pois.tip: Hire a pedal boat or country canoe from the local boat club for exploring the mangrove backwaters.

pois.name: Cafe Del Mar Varkala
pois.address: North Cliff, Kurakkanni, Varkala, Kerala 695141, India
pois.description: Popular North Cliff eatery serving coastal Kerala vegetarian delicacies, fresh juices, and international light dining overlooking the ocean.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Unobstructed sunset ocean cliff seating
✓ Excellent Kerala vegetarian curries, appams, and artisan coffees
pois.tip: Arrive around 5:15 PM to snag a prime front-row cliff view table for sunset.
pois.signature_dish: Kerala vegetable stew with fluffy hot appams

provenance.price_source: A la carte menu (No entry ticket)
